```{r Compile and Read in expression matrix}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Import expression matrix
##============================================================================##
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(writexl)

setwd(file.path(root_path, data_folder, "./result/1.3.gene_expression"))
dt <- read_xlsx("FPKM_anno.xlsx", sheet = "FPKM_anno")

dt_df <- dt %>%
  dplyr::select(
    "id",
    "unhealthy-1", "unhealthy-2", "unhealthy-3",
    "healthy-1", "healthy-2", "healthy-3",
    "A5B5-1", "A5B5-2", "A5B5-3"
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("id")

rownames <- rownames(dt_df)

matrix <- as.matrix(dt_df)
matrix_num <- matrix(as.numeric(matrix), nrow = nrow(matrix), ncol = ncol(matrix))
matrix_log <- log2(matrix_num + 1)

rownames(matrix_log) <- rownames(dt_df)
colnames(matrix_log) <- colnames(dt_df)

clinical <- data.frame(
  group = c(rep("Unhealthy", 3), rep("Healthy", 3), rep("A5B5", 3)),
  samples = c(
    "unhealthy-1", "unhealthy-2", "unhealthy-3",
    "healthy-1", "healthy-2", "healthy-3",
    "A5B5-1", "A5B5-2", "A5B5-3"
  )
)

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "RNA-01.Exp,DEGs"))
saveRDS(matrix_log, file = "matrix_Log2FPKM.Rds")
saveRDS(clinical, file = "clinical.Rds")

df_matrix_log <- data.frame(matrix_log, row.names = rownames)
colnames(df_matrix_log) <- colnames(dt_df)
df_matrix_log_output <- df_matrix_log %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("genes")
write_xlsx(df_matrix_log_output, path = "matrix_Log2FPKM.xlsx")

# Load expression matrix
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "RNA-01.Exp,DEGs"))
matrix <- readRDS("matrix_Log2FPKM.Rds")
clinical <- readRDS("clinical.Rds")
```

```{r PCA Analysis}
##============================================================================##
# Program: PCA analysis
##============================================================================##
library(tidyverse)

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "RNA-01.Exp,DEGs"))
matrix <- readRDS("matrix_Log2FPKM.Rds")
clinical <- readRDS("clinical.Rds")

clinical$Group <- clinical$group
clinical$Group <- factor(clinical$Group, levels = c("Unhealthy", "Healthy", "A5B5"))

library(Rtsne)

fxx.plot_tsne <- function(tsne_data,
                          group = NULL,
                          x_col = "TSNE1",
                          y_col = "TSNE2",
                          mycol = NULL) {
  
  library(doBy)
  library(Rtsne)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(tidyverse)
  
  # Check required columns
  if (!all(c(x_col, y_col) %in% colnames(tsne_data))) {
    stop(paste("Error: Required columns", x_col, "and/or", y_col, "not found in the data."))
  }
  
  # Automatically detect grouping column if not provided
  if (is.null(group)) {
    other_cols <- setdiff(colnames(tsne_data), c(x_col, y_col))
    tsne_data <- tsne_data[, c(x_col, y_col, other_cols)]
    
    potential_group <- NULL
    for (col in colnames(tsne_data)[3:ncol(tsne_data)]) {
      n_unique <- length(unique(tsne_data[[col]]))
      if (n_unique > 1 && n_unique < nrow(tsne_data)) {
        potential_group <- col
        break
      }
    }
    
    if (is.null(potential_group)) {
      stop("Error: No suitable grouping column found. Please specify 'group' manually.")
    }
    
    group <- potential_group
  }
  
  # Load color function if needed
  if (!exists("fxx.get_many_color")) {
    if (!file.exists(file.path(root_path, code_folder, "fxx.get_many_color.R"))) {
      stop("Error: fxx.get_many_color.R not found. Please check the file path.")
    }
    source(file.path(root_path, code_folder, "fxx.get_many_color.R"))
  }
  
  # Generate colors automatically if not provided
  if (is.null(mycol)) {
    n_groups <- length(unique(tsne_data[[group]]))
    if (n_groups > 100) {
      stop("Error: Too many groups (>100). Please specify 'mycol' manually.")
    }
    mycol <- fxx.get_many_color(n_groups)
  }
  
  plot_list <- list()
  
  # Check grouping column
  if (!group %in% colnames(tsne_data)) {
    stop(paste("Error: Group column", group, "not found in the data."))
  }
  
  mytheme <- theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Base scatter plot
  p <- ggplot(data = tsne_data, aes_string(x = x_col, y = y_col)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    labs(x = paste0(x_col, "_PC1"), y = paste0(y_col, "_PC2")) +
    mytheme
  plot_list[["base"]] <- p
  
  # Colored scatter plot
  p1 <- p +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, aes_string(col = group)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = mycol)
  plot_list[["colored"]] <- p1
  
  # Add shapes
  p2 <- p1 +
    aes_string(shape = group) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 15:(14 + length(mycol)))
  plot_list[["shaped"]] <- p2
  
  # Add confidence ellipses
  p3 <- p2 +
    stat_ellipse(aes_string(color = group), level = 0.95, linetype = 2)
  plot_list[["ellipse"]] <- p3
  
  # Filled confidence ellipses
  p4 <- p2 +
    stat_ellipse(aes_string(fill = group), level = 0.95, geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol)
  plot_list[["filled_ellipse"]] <- p4
  
  # Filled ellipses with borders
  p5 <- p2 +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes_string(fill = group, color = group),
      level = 0.95,
      linetype = 2,
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol)
  plot_list[["filled_bordered_ellipse"]] <- p5
  
  # Compute group means
  formula_str <- paste(paste(x_col, y_col, sep = " + "), group, sep = " ~ ")
  tsne_mean <- summaryBy(as.formula(formula_str), tsne_data, FUN = mean)
  tsne <- merge(tsne_data, tsne_mean, by = group)
  
  # Firework-style centroid plot
  p6 <- ggplot(data = tsne, aes_string(x = x_col, y = y_col)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.2, aes_string(col = group, shape = group)) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = 15:(14 + length(mycol))) +
    scale_color_manual(values = mycol) +
    labs(x = paste0(x_col, "_PC1"), y = paste0(y_col, "_PC2")) +
    mytheme
  plot_list[["firework_base"]] <- p6
  
  mean_x_col <- paste0(x_col, ".mean")
  mean_y_col <- paste0(y_col, ".mean")
  
  # Connect points to group centroids
  p7 <- p6 +
    geom_segment(
      data = tsne,
      aes_string(
        x = mean_x_col,
        y = mean_y_col,
        xend = x_col,
        yend = y_col,
        color = group
      ),
      alpha = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  plot_list[["firework_centroid"]] <- p7
  
  # Firework plot with filled ellipses
  p8 <- p6 +
    stat_ellipse(
      aes_string(fill = group),
      level = 0.95,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      geom = "polygon",
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = mycol) +
    geom_segment(
      data = tsne,
      aes_string(
        x = mean_x_col,
        y = mean_y_col,
        xend = x_col,
        yend = y_col,
        color = group
      ),
      alpha = 0.6,
      show.legend = FALSE
    )
  plot_list[["firework_ellipse"]] <- p8
  
  return(plot_list)
}

fxx.plot_pca <- function(pca_data,
                         group = NULL,
                         x_col = "PC1",
                         y_col = "PC2",
                         mycol = NULL) {

  if (!all(c(x_col, y_col) %in% colnames(pca_data))) {
    stop("Required columns not found: ", x_col, " and/or ", y_col, call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (is.null(group)) {
    other_cols <- setdiff(colnames(pca_data), c(x_col, y_col))
    pca_data <- pca_data[, c(x_col, y_col, other_cols), drop = FALSE]

    potential_group <- NULL
    for (col in colnames(pca_data)[3:ncol(pca_data)]) {
      n_unique <- length(unique(pca_data[[col]]))
      if (n_unique > 1 && n_unique < nrow(pca_data)) {
        potential_group <- col
        break
      }
    }

    if (is.null(potential_group)) {
      stop("No suitable grouping column found. Please specify 'group' manually.", call. = FALSE)
    }

    group <- potential_group
    message("Using column '", group, "' as grouping variable. ",
            "Number of groups: ", length(unique(pca_data[[group]])))
  }

  if (!group %in% colnames(pca_data)) {
    stop("Group column not found: ", group, call. = FALSE)
  }

  if (is.null(mycol)) {
    n_groups <- length(unique(pca_data[[group]]))
    if (n_groups > 100) {
      stop("Too many groups (>100). Please specify 'mycol' manually.", call. = FALSE)
    }
    mycol <- fxx.get_many_color(n_groups)
  }

  plot_list <- list()

  mytheme <- ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.title = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.background = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      axis.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
      strip.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6)
    )

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(pca_data, ggplot2::aes(.data[[x_col]], .data[[y_col]])) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(size = 2.2) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = x_col, y = y_col) +
    mytheme
  plot_list[["base"]] <- p

  p1 <- p +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = .data[[group]]), size = 2.2) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = mycol)
  plot_list[["colored"]] <- p1

  p2 <- p1 +
    ggplot2::aes(shape = .data[[group]]) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = 15:(14 + length(mycol)))
  plot_list[["shaped"]] <- p2

  p3 <- p2 +
    ggplot2::stat_ellipse(ggplot2::aes(color = .data[[group]]), level = 0.95, linetype = 2)
  plot_list[["ellipse"]] <- p3

  p4 <- p2 +
    ggplot2::stat_ellipse(ggplot2::aes(fill = .data[[group]]), level = 0.95,
                          geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mycol)
  plot_list[["filled_ellipse"]] <- p4

  p5 <- p2 +
    ggplot2::stat_ellipse(ggplot2::aes(fill = .data[[group]], color = .data[[group]]),
                          level = 0.95, linetype = 2, geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mycol)
  plot_list[["filled_bordered_ellipse"]] <- p5

  formula_str <- paste(paste(x_col, y_col, sep = " + "), group, sep = " ~ ")
  pca_mean <- doBy::summaryBy(stats::as.formula(formula_str), data = pca_data, FUN = mean)
  pca <- merge(pca_data, pca_mean, by = group)

  mean_x_col <- paste0(x_col, ".mean")
  mean_y_col <- paste0(y_col, ".mean")

  p6 <- ggplot2::ggplot(pca, ggplot2::aes(.data[[x_col]], .data[[y_col]])) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = .data[[group]], shape = .data[[group]]), size = 2.2) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = 15:(14 + length(mycol))) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = mycol) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = x_col, y = y_col) +
    mytheme
  plot_list[["firework_base"]] <- p6

  p7 <- p6 +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = pca,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data[[mean_x_col]], y = .data[[mean_y_col]],
        xend = .data[[x_col]], yend = .data[[y_col]], color = .data[[group]]
      ),
      alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    )
  plot_list[["firework_centroid"]] <- p7

  p8 <- p6 +
    ggplot2::stat_ellipse(
      ggplot2::aes(fill = .data[[group]]),
      level = 0.95, show.legend = FALSE, geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mycol) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(
      data = pca,
      ggplot2::aes(
        x = .data[[mean_x_col]], y = .data[[mean_y_col]],
        xend = .data[[x_col]], yend = .data[[y_col]], color = .data[[group]]
      ),
      alpha = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    )
  plot_list[["firework_ellipse"]] <- p8

  plot_list
}

# Output directory
out_dir <- "RNA-01.PCA/seed27"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
# Prepare matrix
matrix_t <- t(matrix)
# Color palette
my_colors <- c(
  "Unhealthy" = "#8F5F9F",
  "Healthy" = "#EB9123",
  "A5B5" = "#315E85"
)
# tSNE analysis
set.seed(27)
library(Rtsne)
tsne_out <- Rtsne(matrix_t, dims = 2, perplexity = 2, verbose = TRUE)
tsne_data <- data.frame(
  TSNE1 = tsne_out$Y[, 1],
  TSNE2 = tsne_out$Y[, 2],
  Group = clinical$Group
)
tsne_plots <- fxx.plot_tsne(tsne_data, group = "Group", mycol = my_colors)
# PCA analysis
pca_out <- prcomp(matrix_t, scale = TRUE)
pca_data <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_out$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_out$x[, 2],
  Group = clinical$Group
)
pca_plots <- fxx.plot_pca(pca_data, group = "Group", mycol = my_colors)
# Save plots
plot_names <- c(
  "base", "colored", "shaped", "ellipse",
  "filled_ellipse", "filled_bordered_ellipse",
  "firework_base", "firework_centroid", "firework_ellipse"
)
for (plot_name in plot_names) {
  plot_obj <- tsne_plots[[plot_name]]
  fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
    final_folder = out_dir,
    p = plot_obj,
    p_filename = paste0("tSNE_All_samples_", plot_name),
    width = 3.4,
    height = 2.7
  )
}
for (plot_name in plot_names) {
  plot_obj <- pca_plots[[plot_name]]
  fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
    final_folder = out_dir,
    p = plot_obj,
    p_filename = paste0("PCA_All_samples_", plot_name),
    width = 3.4,
    height = 2.7
  )
}
```

```{r Volcano plot for differential expression analysis}
##============================================================================##
# Program: Volcano plot for differential expression analysis
##============================================================================##
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "RNA-02.DEseq"))
degs_list <- readRDS(file = "degs_list.Rds")

my_colors <- c(
  "Unhealthy" = "#8F5F9F",
  "Healthy" = "#EB9123",
  "A5B5" = "#315E85"
)

parse_contrast_ctrl_exp <- function(contrast_name) {
  parts <- strsplit(contrast_name, "_")[[1]]
  if (length(parts) != 2) {
    stop("contrast_name must follow the format Control_Experiment, e.g. Healthy_A5B5: ", contrast_name)
  }
  list(control = parts[1], experiment = parts[2])
}

plot_volcano_for_contrast <- function(list_obj,
                                      contrast_name,
                                      gene_col = "gene_id",
                                      lfc_col  = "log2FoldChange",
                                      q_col    = "q-value",
                                      q_thresh = 0.05,
                                      draw_cut_lines = TRUE) {
  
  grp <- parse_contrast_ctrl_exp(contrast_name)
  control <- grp$control
  experiment <- grp$experiment
  
  if (!control %in% names(my_colors)) {
    stop("Missing control group color in my_colors: ", control,
         "\nAvailable keys: ", paste(names(my_colors), collapse = ", "))
  }
  if (!experiment %in% names(my_colors)) {
    stop("Missing experiment group color in my_colors: ", experiment,
         "\nAvailable keys: ", paste(names(my_colors), collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  df0 <- list_obj[[contrast_name]]
  if (is.null(df0)) stop("Contrast not found in degs_list: ", contrast_name)
  
  need_cols <- c(gene_col, lfc_col, q_col)
  miss <- setdiff(need_cols, colnames(df0))
  if (length(miss) > 0) {
    stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
         "\nCurrent columns: ", paste(colnames(df0), collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  df <- df0 %>%
    transmute(
      gene   = .data[[gene_col]],
      log2FC = as.numeric(.data[[lfc_col]]),
      qvalue = as.numeric(.data[[q_col]])
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(log2FC), !is.na(qvalue)) %>%
    mutate(
      significant = qvalue < q_thresh,
      regulation = case_when(
        significant & log2FC > 0 ~ "Up",
        significant & log2FC < 0 ~ "Down",
        TRUE ~ "NotSig"
      ),
      color = case_when(
        regulation == "Up" ~ unname(my_colors[experiment]),
        regulation == "Down" ~ unname(my_colors[control]),
        TRUE ~ "grey80"
      ),
      y = -log10(qvalue)
    )
  
  round_down_05 <- function(x) floor(x * 2) / 2
  round_up_05 <- function(x) ceiling(x * 2) / 2
  
  x_min <- min(df$log2FC)
  x_max <- max(df$log2FC)
  y_min <- min(df$y)
  y_max <- max(df$y)
  
  if (x_min == x_max) x_min <- x_min - 1e-6
  if (y_min == y_max) y_max <- y_max + 1e-6
  
  x_lim <- c(round_down_05(x_min), round_up_05(x_max))
  y_lim <- c(round_down_05(y_min), round_up_05(y_max))
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = y)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = color), size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    labs(
      x = "Log2 Fold Change (Experiment vs Control)",
      y = "-Log10(q-value)",
      title = paste0("Experiment ", experiment, ", Control ", control)
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = x_lim, ylim = y_lim) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#000000", size = 6),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#000000", size = 6),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 6, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.75),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)
    )
  
  if (draw_cut_lines) {
    p <- p +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.75) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(q_thresh), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.75)
  }
  
  p
}

p1 <- plot_volcano_for_contrast(degs_list, "Healthy_A5B5", draw_cut_lines = TRUE)
p2 <- plot_volcano_for_contrast(degs_list, "Unhealthy_A5B5", draw_cut_lines = TRUE)
p3 <- plot_volcano_for_contrast(degs_list, "Healthy_Unhealthy", draw_cut_lines = TRUE)

p1.NoVline <- plot_volcano_for_contrast(degs_list, "Healthy_A5B5", draw_cut_lines = FALSE)
p2.NoVline <- plot_volcano_for_contrast(degs_list, "Unhealthy_A5B5", draw_cut_lines = FALSE)
p3.NoVline <- plot_volcano_for_contrast(degs_list, "Healthy_Unhealthy", draw_cut_lines = FALSE)

out_dir <- "RNA-02.DEseq-VolPlot"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))
```

```{r DEGs intersection}
    dplyr::pull(gene_id)
```

```{r Intersected DEGs pathway enrichment analysis}
  "CD300A","CD37","CD40","CD86","CD93","CDH5"
)

# Convert SYMBOL to ENTREZID

ego_mf <- enrichGO(

df_cc <- as.data.frame(ego_cc) %>% mutate(ONTOLOGY = "CC")

}

saveWorkbook(wb, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r TCSeq cluster analysis}
##============================================================================##
# Program: TCseq
##============================================================================##

# Load expression matrix and clinical metadata
setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, "RNA-01.Exp,DEGs"))
matrix <- readRDS("matrix_Log2FPKM.Rds")
clinical <- readRDS("clinical.Rds") %>%
  mutate(Group = group)

clinical$group <- factor(clinical$group, levels = c("Healthy", "Unhealthy", "A5B5"))
clinical$Group <- factor(clinical$Group, levels = c("Healthy", "Unhealthy", "A5B5"))

# Set output directory
out_dir <- "RNA-05-1.TCseq"
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir))

# Ensure matrix columns follow the sample order in clinical
matrix <- matrix[, clinical$samples]

# Average expression within each group
unique_groups <- levels(clinical$group)
mean_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(matrix), ncol = length(unique_groups))
rownames(mean_matrix) <- rownames(matrix)
colnames(mean_matrix) <- unique_groups

for (group in unique_groups) {
  group_samples <- clinical$samples[clinical$group == group]
  mean_matrix[, group] <- rowMeans(matrix[, group_samples])
}

matrix_mean <- mean_matrix

# Custom color palette
custom_colors <- c("#224263", "#3D77B1", "#759AD5", "#F5F4F8", "#D27890", "#99334D", "#682234")

# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(TCseq)
library(RColorBrewer)

# TCseq clustering for k = 2 to 10
set.seed(11)
data <- as.matrix(matrix_mean)

tca_results <- list()
cluster_proteininfo_list <- list()

for (k_value in 2:10) {
  tca_results[[k_value]] <- timeclust(
    x = data,
    algo = "cm",
    k = k_value,
    standardize = TRUE
  )

  p <- timeclustplot(tca_results[[k_value]], categories = "Treatment", cols = 3)
  p1 <- timeclustplot(
    tca_results[[k_value]],
    categories = "Treatment",
    cols = 3,
    membership.color = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(11, "PiYG"))(11)
  )
  p2 <- timeclustplot(
    tca_results[[k_value]],
    categories = "Treatment",
    cols = 3,
    membership.color = colorRampPalette(custom_colors)(11)
  )

  cluster_proteininfo_list[[k_value]] <- clustCluster(tca_results[[k_value]])

  sub_dir <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("cluster=", k_value))
  fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, sub_dir))

  saveRDS(
    cluster_proteininfo_list[[k_value]],
    paste0("TCseq_proteininfo.k", k_value, ".Rds")
  )

  writexl::write_xlsx(
    data.frame(
      protein = names(cluster_proteininfo_list[[k_value]]),
      cluster = cluster_proteininfo_list[[k_value]]
    ),
    paste0("TCseq_proteininfo.k", k_value, ".xlsx")
  )

  for (i in 1:k_value) {
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
      final_folder = sub_dir,
      p_filename = str_c("TCseq_clusterplot_k", k_value, "_cluster", i, ".col-0"),
      p = p[[i]],
      height = 3,
      width = 4.6,
      dpi = 600
    )
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
      final_folder = sub_dir,
      p_filename = str_c("TCseq_clusterplot_k", k_value, "_cluster", i, ".col-1"),
      p = p1[[i]],
      height = 3,
      width = 4.6,
      dpi = 600
    )
    fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
      final_folder = sub_dir,
      p_filename = str_c("TCseq_clusterplot_k", k_value, "_cluster", i, ".col-2"),
      p = p2[[i]],
      height = 3,
      width = 4.6,
      dpi = 600
    )
  }
}

# Save all results
sub_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "all_k_results")
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, sub_dir))
saveRDS(tca_results, "all_tca_results.Rds")
saveRDS(cluster_proteininfo_list, "all_cluster_proteininfo.Rds")


##---------------------------------------------------------------------------##
# Program: Re-plot TCseq results for k = 6 with updated color palette
##---------------------------------------------------------------------------##

library(tidyverse)
library(TCseq)

out_dir <- "RNA-05-1.TCseq"
all_results_dir <- file.path(root_path, res_folder, out_dir, "all_k_results")

tca_results <- readRDS(file.path(all_results_dir, "all_tca_results.Rds"))
tca_k6 <- tca_results[[6]]

custom_colors <- c("#224263", "#3D77B1", "#759AD5", "#F5F4F8", "#D27890", "#99334D", "#682234")

p2 <- timeclustplot(
  tca_k6,
  categories = "Treatment",
  cols = 3,
  membership.color = colorRampPalette(custom_colors)(11)
)

k_value <- 6
sub_dir <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("cluster=", k_value))
fxx.create_and_setwd(file.path(root_path, res_folder, sub_dir))

for (i in 1:k_value) {
  fxx.save_ggplot2_obj2res(
    final_folder = sub_dir,
    p_filename = str_c("TCseq_clusterplot_k", k_value, "_cluster", i, ".col-2"),
    p = p2[[i]],
    height = 3,
    width = 4.6,
    dpi = 600
  )
}
```

```{r Pathway enrichment analysis of  TCseq cluster 2 and cluster 5}
df_bp <- as.data.frame(ego_bp) %>% mutate(ONTOLOGY = "BP")
df_cc <- as.data.frame(ego_cc) %>% mutate(ONTOLOGY = "CC")
df_mf <- as.data.frame(ego_mf) %>% mutate(ONTOLOGY = "MF")

df_all <- bind_rows(df_bp, df_cc, df_mf) %>%
  arrange(p.adjust, pvalue)

out_xlsx <- "GO_enrichment_results(disease_low_genes).xlsx"

wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "BP")
addWorksheet(wb, "CC")
addWorksheet(wb, "MF")
addWorksheet(wb, "all")

writeData(wb, "BP", df_bp)
writeData(wb, "CC", df_cc)
writeData(wb, "MF", df_mf)
writeData(wb, "all", df_all)

for (sh in c("BP", "CC", "MF", "all")) {
  addFilter(wb, sh, rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(readWorkbook(wb, sheet = sh, rows = 1)))
  freezePane(wb, sh, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, sh, cols = 1:50, widths = "auto")
}

saveWorkbook(wb, out_xlsx, overwrite = TRUE)
```
